list-pdf-form-field-names.title: List PDF Form Field Names using FormEditor
list-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF with FormEditor, retrieve all AcroForm field names, and output them to the console. Includes code to create a minimal PDF with a sample TextBox field if the input file is missing.

add-text-field-to-pdf.title: Add Text Field to PDF Using FormEditor
add-text-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a new text field at specific coordinates on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor facade and then save the modified document.

fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.title: Fill TextBox Field in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF, fill a specific AcroForm textbox field with a string using Form.FillField, and save the modified document.

justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.title: Justify Text in a PDF Form TextBox
justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.description: Shows how to apply justified alignment to a filled textbox field in an AcroForm by configuring FormFieldFacade and calling FormEditor.DecorateField.

retrieve-radio-button-option-values.title: Retrieve Radio Button Option Values from a PDF Form
retrieve-radio-button-option-values.description: Demonstrates how to use the Form facade to get all option values of a radio button group in an AcroForm and store them in a Hashtable for further processing.

get-selected-radio-button-value.title: Get Selected Radio Button Value from PDF Form
get-selected-radio-button-value.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf.Facades and retrieve the currently selected option of a radio button group using GetButtonOptionCurrentValue.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form to export all AcroForm field values from a PDF document into an XML file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF File
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form class to export all AcroForm field values from a PDF document into an FDF file via a file stream.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Fields to XFDF
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form to export AcroForm data from a PDF into an XFDF file and write it to disk.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON and Verify Structure
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Shows how to export AcroForm field values from a PDF to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf's Form facade and then read the JSON back to confirm the exported structure.

import-form-fields-from-xml.title: Import Form Field Values from XML into PDF
import-form-fields-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing AcroForm fields, import field values from an XML file using Form.ImportXml, and save the populated PDF.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import FDF Data into PDF Form
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to open a PDF form, import field values from an FDF file using a file stream, and save the populated PDF.

import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import XFDF Data into PDF Form
import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read an XFDF file and import its form field values into the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, then save the filled document.

import-json-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form Fields
import-json-data-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a JSON file containing form field values and import them into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, with basic error handling for missing files and I/O issues.

batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Batch Export PDF Form Data to XML
batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Loops through PDF files in a folder, loads each document, and uses the FormEditor and Form facades to export AcroForm data to individual XML files.

batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import JSON Data into PDFs in Parallel
batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.description: Demonstrates importing form field values from matching JSON files into PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and processing multiple files concurrently with Parallel.ForEach.

combine-acroform-json-exports.title: Combine AcroForm JSON Exports from Multiple PDFs
combine-acroform-json-exports.description: The example loads several PDF files, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form to export each document's AcroForm fields to JSON, and merges the resulting JSON objects into a single JSON array written to a file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.description: Shows how to export AcroForm field data from a PDF directly into a memory stream as XML, eliminating the need for intermediate files on disk.

merge-acroform-data-into-json.title: Merge AcroForm Data from Multiple PDFs into JSON
merge-acroform-data-into-json.description: Shows how to iterate over several PDF documents, extract their AcroForm fields with the Form facade, and aggregate the collected values into a single JSON file.

export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.title: Export and Filter PDF Form Fields to XFDF
export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.description: Shows how to export AcroForm fields from a PDF to XFDF, keep only those whose names start with "Customer", and write the filtered XML back to a file.

export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Export Selected AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Shows how to export only specific form fields from a PDF AcroForm to a JSON file by exporting the full form data, filtering the desired fields, and writing the filtered JSON.

import-form-data-from-json.title: Import Form Data from JSON into PDF (Ignore Missing Fields)
import-form-data-from-json.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form, importing field values from a JSON file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form while automatically ignoring fields that are not present in the PDF, and saving the filled document.

validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.title: Validate XML Against XSD and Import into PDF Form
validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to validate an XML file using an XSD schema and then import the validated data into an AcroForm PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.title: Export and Import PDF Form Fields with UTF-8 Encoding
export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.description: Demonstrates exporting AcroForm field values to an XFDF file and re‑importing them using UTF‑8 streams to correctly handle Unicode characters.

list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.title: List PDF Form Fields and Export to CSV
list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.description: Shows how to use FormEditor and the Form facade to enumerate all AcroForm fields in a PDF and write each field's name and type to a CSV report.

export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.title: Export Text AcroForm Field Names to JSON
export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.description: The example opens a PDF, filters AcroForm fields to include only text fields, and writes the field names to a JSON file.

add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.title: Add Radio Button Group to PDF with Default Selection
add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to insert a radio button group with three options into an existing PDF and programmatically set the default selected option.

validate-radio-button-options.title: Validate Radio Button Options in PDF AcroForm
validate-radio-button-options.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with a radio button group, retrieving its option values via the Form facade, and comparing them to an expected set to verify form integrity.

export-import-acroform-xfdf.title: Export and Import AcroForm Data via XFDF
export-import-acroform-xfdf.description: Shows how to fill AcroForm fields, export the data to an XFDF file, import the XFDF back into a fresh PDF, and verify that the field values are preserved after the round‑trip.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from JSON using Aspose.Pdf
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON file into a dictionary, map its keys to AcroForm field names, fill those fields with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, and save the resulting PDF.

update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.title: Update PDF AcroForm Fields from Byte Array
update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array using MemoryStream, fills specified AcroForm fields, and returns the modified PDF as a byte array.

extract-pdf-form-field-names.title: Extract PDF Form Field Names to JSON
extract-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to open a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, retrieve all AcroForm field names, and output them as a JSON array from a command‑line utility.

fill-pdf-acroform-fields.title: Fill PDF AcroForm Fields and Save
fill-pdf-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to open a PDF, populate AcroForm fields from a dictionary, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and Deserialize
export-pdf-form-data-to-json.description: Shows how to export AcroForm fields from a PDF to a JSON string using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and then deserialize the JSON into a strongly‑typed C# object with Json.NET.

import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.title: Import JSON Data into PDF AcroForm
import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.description: Shows how to serialize a C# object to JSON, place it in a memory stream, and import the data into an AcroForm using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and Split into Chunks
export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.description: Demonstrates how to export AcroForm fields from a PDF to a JSON document using Aspose.Pdf and then split the output into multiple files, each containing up to 100 fields.

export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML and Convert to HTML with XSLT
export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.description: Shows how to export AcroForm fields from a PDF to an XML file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and then transform that XML into an HTML view with XSLT.

import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.title: Import XML into PDF Form and Validate Required Fields
import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.description: Demonstrates importing form data from an XML file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, then checking required fields and logging any that are empty.

import-json-data-into-pdf-form__v2.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form with Error Handling
import-json-data-into-pdf-form__v2.description: Demonstrates importing form field values from a JSON file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and handling missing fields by catching exceptions and logging the field name.

async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Asynchronously Export PDF Form Data to XML
async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Demonstrates exporting AcroForm fields from a PDF to an XML file using async/await to keep the UI thread responsive.

create-pdf-form-fields-report.title: Create PDF Report of AcroForm Fields
create-pdf-form-fields-report.description: Demonstrates how to enumerate AcroForm fields in a PDF and generate a new PDF containing a table with each field's name, type, and value.
